visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair styled in two long braids stands outdoors against a grey concrete wall. She wears a vibrant red baseball cap with a gold logo and an orange two-piece bikini top. She looks directly at the camera with a subtle smile, using both hands to adjust the brim of her cap. The background features green foliage from trees behind the wall. (2) The woman turns her head and body to the left, revealing her side profile. A small tattoo is visible on the back of her neck. The camera remains at an eye-level medium close-up, capturing her movement against the flat background. (3) The scene shifts to a full-body shot of the woman leaning against a tall concrete wall. She is now wearing matching orange bikini bottoms and high-top red and black sneakers. She poses with one leg bent against the wall and her right hand resting on her head. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the wall. (4) A final shot shows the woman sitting on a rectangular concrete structure in what appears to be an outdoor fitness area with green flooring. She has both hands raised to her red cap, posing with her legs extended. Metal workout bars are visible in the background among lush green trees.
